review_comments: `_fieldAccessType` is used as the gate for lock-free initialization, so it needs to be volatile and always set last.

My understanding of the volatile semantic tells me it cannot, just wanted to double check. e.g. on arm64 it's going to be:
```
str reg1, [<addr + cns1>]
stlr reg2, [<addr + cns2>] ;; volatile
```
Right, we have it written down in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/docs/design/specs/Memory-model.md#order-of-memory-operations
